title: Evidence strength scorecard: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Three of the four findings rest on one document each; a second source of another type would strengthen them most.

items.text: This scorecard shows where more evidence would strengthen confidence. It does not grade the investigation team.

rows: codes named in causal text that no finding carries

items.question: Does the maintenance log show whether a leak test was planned for the restart?
items.why: The level 1 finding on the untested restart rests on one work order (EVD-0001), a single document.
items.good_evidence: The maintenance log entry for the job, and the fitter's account of the restart

items.question: Is there a record of a return-to-service checklist ever being drafted or withdrawn?
items.why: The level 3 finding on the missing checklist rests on the procedure index alone (EVD-0002), and no level 3 finding cites a witness.
items.good_evidence: Procedure change history, and an account from the supervisor who signs off restarts

sections.heading: What this scorecard cannot tell you

items.text: The scorecard counts the evidence links the export records. It cannot judge how reliable a document or a statement is, and one strong source can outweigh several weak ones.
